title: Wizard spells look the part
changes: Thunder: each strike is a thick double bolt with a white flash, a shock ring of sparks and dust, rocks thrown up and the ground shaking; glowing cracks tear out from the point of impact and cool into scars
Blizzard: a much denser storm, with a haze of driven snow and ice shards whipping round you
Fire Bolt: a bigger fiery comet with twisting flame ribbons and embers, and a real explosion where it lands
